# NEW 2026-11-18 Yuan track Y4 (events 1337-1351, oe_yv_). Generated by gen_yuan_y4.py; edit the generator, not this file.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_yv_pulse } }

# CHI. The first pulse decides once whether this is a new 1337 game; then monthly while the schedule is on
# (or while an M6 modifier needs monthly cleanup after the schedule ends).
oe_yv_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        tag = CHI
        OR = {
            has_variable = oe_yv_on
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_yv_init }
            has_country_modifier = oe_yv_sole_chancellor
            has_country_modifier = oe_yv_divided_chancery
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_yv_init } }
            set_variable = oe_yv_init
            if = {
                limit = { current_date >= 1337.1.1 current_date < 1337.6.1 }
                set_variable = oe_yv_on
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_yv_on } oe_yv_ev_monthly = yes }
        else = { oe_yv_m6_cleanup = yes }
    }
}
